notes: Torah #233 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The Torah has 2 bechina edges in the dataset (holy thoughts = pure animals, evil thoughts = impure animals), yielding two packages (Package 1: holy thoughts/pure animals, good; Package 2: evil thoughts/impure animals, evil). All 4 nodes are already assigned to bechina packages. The Torah does contain implicit causal content — overcoming evil thoughts produces divine pleasure (תענוג); redirecting thought to Torah/prayer/business displaces evil thoughts — but these causal relationships were not encoded as eitza edges. With zero cause/effect edges, there are no unassigned nodes to process.
